Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and the State.

2. The prayer is for:
(i). Issuance of writ in the nature of mandamus commanding the respondents to pay the compensation under Right to Fair Compensation and transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
(ii). Issuance of any other writ/order/direction as your Lordships may deem fit and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case.
3. Two sets of people earlier moved this Court in C.W.J.C. No. 19729 of 2010 (disposed of on 22.04.2014) as also C.W.J.C. No. 10844 of 2014 (disposed of on 22.12.2016) and in the last writ petition, it was specifically observed as follows:

entities.text: Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: In view of the aforesaid, the writ petition Patna High Court CWJC No.4014 of 2020(18) dt.12-02-2024 stands disposed of recording the undertaking given both in the counter affidavit as well as by learned State counsel that payment shall be made to the persons whose lands have been acquired including the petitioner, subject to actual verification and measurement on which the compensation amount will depend, latest by 30th April, 2017.
The Court hopes and trusts that the State Authorities shall not give any opportunity to the persons concerned to approach this Court again on account of non-compliance of this order.
4. Since, the respondents have failed to take note of the observations made by the Court almost eight years ago, the present writ petition filed which is pending since the year 2020.

He as such prays for four weeks' time for filing an appropriate reply addressing to the letters sent by the District Magistrate, Jehanabad, as incorporated above.

8. As a last chance four weeks time is granted to file an appropriate reply on behalf of the respondent No. 02, failing which a cost of Rs. 5,000/- shall be deposited with the Patna High Court Legal Services Committee.
